QuestInfo.name: A Debt Repaid
QuestInfo.0: Now that the safe is open, you can collect on Antuin's debt. Talk to #bAntuin#k.
QuestInfo.1: Just as you're about to collect the money, Anzu shows up. It turns out he's Antuin's grandson. Looks like there's a story here.
QuestInfo.2: Anzu departed, and Antuin handed over the money he owed before griping about his grandson.

1.0: I'm sorry... I know you were just doing your job...\r\n

yes.0: Please forgive my grandson. He was a smart boy once, with a bright future ahead of him... But I'm afraid he went down a dark path after losing his parents in an accident.\r\n

default.0: Here's what I owe Gen. That's all there was in the safe, anyway. What a coincidence.\r\n
